MONTREAL, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cerro de Pasco Resources Inc. (TSXV CDPR | OTCQX CDPMF | FRA N8HP | BVL CDPR) ("CDPR" or the "Company") announces that Guy Goulet will retire as Chief Executive Officer and step down from the Board of Directors effective today. As part of the succession plan discussed by the Governance Committee of the Board in June 2026, the Board has appointed Steven Zadka, the Company's founder and Executive Chairman, as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer effective the same date.

"With heartfelt appreciation, we mark Guy's retirement after nearly ten years as our Chief Executive Officer," said Steven Zadka. "Throughout his tenure, Guy has been an integral part of our company's journey, bringing dedication, leadership and a genuine commitment to our project and our vision. As he moves on to his next chapter, his contributions and the relationships he has built will remain a meaningful part of our company's story.

"Guy has been a mentor to me, and working alongside him has been a great pleasure. He is a veteran with 40 years in this industry who has led and built public companies in mining and beyond. He will always hold a special place in the heart of CDPR. We are deeply grateful for his years of service and wish him nothing but continued success, happiness and fulfillment in all that lies ahead."

"Leading CDPR has been one of the great privileges of my career," said Guy Goulet. "I have always called Steven the architect of this project. He founded this company, led our work in Peru, built our technical team and brought the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation in as a funding partner. CDPR is a much stronger company than it was a few years ago and now operates at an institutional level, and Steven has been instrumental in that.

"I have also always said that a CEO's job is to replace himself with someone better, and in Steven I have. He brings a background in investment banking that I do not have, and over the past year he has built a real command of this project's metallurgy working side by side with our technical team. He is a shareholder himself and he thinks like one. I have complete confidence in him to take CDPR to the next level, and I could not leave the Company in better hands."

The Board extends its deep appreciation and sincere thanks to Mr. Goulet for his contribution to the Company. John G. Booth continues as the Company's Lead Independent Director. The Company's strategy and priorities are unchanged.

About Cerro de Pasco Resources

Cerro de Pasco Resources Inc. is focused on developing its 100%-owned El Metalurgista concession in central Peru, which hosts silver-rich tailings and stockpiles accumulated over more than a century of mining in one of the most prolific polymetallic districts in the Americas. The Company's strategy is to reprocess historic mining waste to recover value while addressing the long-term environmental liabilities associated with these tailings.

New Leadership Safeguards Significant Tax Assets to Shield Future Taxable Income and Support Plan to Return PetMeds to Sustainable Profitability and Drive Shareholder Value

Concurrently Terminates Prior Limited Duration Shareholder Rights Plan

DELRAY BEACH, Fla., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PetMed Express, Inc., dba PetMeds and parent company of PetCareRx, (Nasdaq: PETS) (the “Company”), today announced that its Board of Directors has approved the adoption of a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan (or “the plan”) which is effective immediately. The plan is specifically tailored to protect and preserve PetMeds’ potentially valuable tax assets primarily associated with net operating loss carryforwards or NOLs that could be utilized in certain circumstances to offset PetMeds’ future taxable income and reduce its future federal income tax liability.

Concurrently, the Board approved the immediate termination of PetMeds’ prior limited duration shareholder rights plan, originally adopted on December 3, 2024, by accelerating its final expiration date from the close of business on December 2, 2026 to 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on November 27, 2026. Accordingly, all Rights issued thereunder have expired, without any consideration or payment being made in respect thereof, and no person has any further rights, obligations, or liabilities thereunder, except for those provisions of that rights plan that by their express terms survive termination (including, without limitation, the indemnification, exculpation, and limitation of liability obligations of PetMeds to the Rights Agent).

New Leadership Mandate and Strategic Rationale for Protecting and Preserving NOLs

Following the appointment of Jeff Willard as PetMeds’ President and Chief Executive Officer, the new leadership of PetMeds reviewed its operations, capital structure, and asset base to optimize the use of all assets and establish a direct, clear path back to sustainable profitability and growth. As part of this asset-optimization strategy, management identified PetMeds’ accumulated NOLs as a balance sheet asset that needed to be protected and preserved.

Over the approximately two years since the adoption of the prior rights plan, PetMeds has incurred operating losses that generated significant federal NOL carryforwards. Relative to PetMeds’ current market capitalization, these tax attributes represent a material and potentially valuable corporate asset. Because an “ownership change” under Section 382 of the Internal Revenue Code (“Section 382”) could severely restrict or permanently eliminate PetMeds’ ability to utilize these tax attributes, the Board determined that adopting a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan directly supports leadership’s plans to optimize the use of all assets, return PetMeds to sustainable profitability and growth, and drive long-term shareholder value.

“Since taking the helm in September, my top priority has been conducting a comprehensive review of our strategy, execution, and balance sheet to identify every available lever to restore PetMeds to profitability, strengthen our financial position, and drive long-term shareholder value,” said Jeff Willard, President and Chief Executive Officer of PetMeds. “In a turnaround, speed matters. We are moving at a new pace, focused on repositioning the brand, upgrading our e-commerce experience, and taking costs out of the business. Our substantial net operating loss carryforwards represent a material asset that we hope to eventually monetize. As we work to return PetMeds to profitable growth, these tax assets can help shield future taxable income and drive long-term shareholder value. Adopting a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan helps protect these tax assets for the benefit of all PetMeds shareholders as our turnaround takes hold.”

Preservation of Net Operating Loss Carryforwards

As of November 2026, PetMeds had an estimate of approximately $43.4 million in federal NOL carryforwards available to offset future corporate income tax obligations. PetMeds’ ability to fully utilize these tax assets could be substantially limited if PetMeds undergoes an “ownership change” as defined under Section 382.

In general, an ownership change occurs under Section 382 if the aggregate percentage stock ownership of one or more “5-percent shareholders” (as defined for tax purposes) increases by more than 50 percentage points over a rolling three-year period over the lowest percentage of stock owned by such shareholders during that period.

In order to protect PetMeds’ NOLs from being limited or permanently lost under Section 382, the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan is intended to reduce the likelihood of an unintended “ownership change” occurring by deterring any person or group from acquiring beneficial ownership of 4.9% or more of PetMeds’ outstanding common stock without the approval of the Board. PetMeds’ Tax Benefit Preservation Plan does not, however, block anyone from buying or selling PetMeds’ common stock. Accordingly, there can be no assurance that the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan will prevent an “ownership change.” PetMeds’ Tax Benefit Preservation Plan is similar to those plans adopted by numerous other public companies with significant NOLs.

Key Terms of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan

Under the terms of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan, PetMeds will distribute to its shareholders one Series B preferred stock purchase right for each share of PetMeds’ common stock held as of the close of business on December 7, 2026. Any shares of common stock issued after the December 7, 2026 record date will be issued together with associated preferred stock purchase rights.

Under the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan, the rights will initially trade with PetMeds’ common stock. The rights will generally become exercisable only if a person (or any persons acting as a group) acquires beneficial ownership of 4.9% or more of PetMeds’ outstanding common stock, without the approval of the Board, after the first public announcement by PetMeds of the adoption of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan. A person or group who acquires, without the approval of the Board, beneficial ownership of 4.9% or more of PetMeds’ outstanding common stock could be subject to significant dilution.

If the preferred stock purchase rights become exercisable, all holders of rights, other than the person or group triggering the rights, will be entitled to purchase PetMeds’ common stock at a 50% discount. The Board also has the option to cause the exchange of one share of common stock for each preferred stock purchase right held (other than the rights held by the person or group triggering the rights). Preferred stock purchase rights held by the person or group triggering the rights will become null and void and will not be exercisable, exchangeable, or transferable.

Shareholders who beneficially owned 4.9% or more of PetMeds’ outstanding common stock prior to the first public announcement by PetMeds of the adoption of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan will not trigger any penalties under the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan so long as they do not acquire beneficial ownership of any additional shares of common stock (other than pursuant to a stock split, stock dividend, reclassification, or similar transaction effected by PetMeds) at a time when they still beneficially own 4.9% or more of such common stock. The Board also has the discretion to exempt any acquisition of PetMeds’ common stock from the provisions of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan.

The preferred stock purchase rights and the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan will expire no later than November 25, 2029 unless the plan is extended. The preferred stock purchase rights and the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan may also expire on an earlier date upon the occurrence of other events, including a determination by the PetMeds Board that the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan is no longer necessary for the preservation of PetMeds’ tax attributes, PetMeds’ tax attributes are fully utilized or no longer available under applicable tax law, or the plan is no longer in the best interests of PetMeds and its shareholders. The preferred stock purchase rights may also be redeemed, exchanged, or terminated prior to their expiration.

PetMeds intends to submit the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan for ratification by PetMeds’ shareholders at its 2027 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The date of PetMeds’ 2027 Annual Meeting of Shareholders has not yet been announced.

Additional Information

Additional information with respect to the termination of the prior rights plan and the adoption of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan will be contained in the related Current Reports on Form 8-K and Registration Statements on Form 8-A that PetMeds will file with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Copies of these documents can be obtained free of charge, when available, at the SEC’s website, www.sec.gov, and at PetMeds’ website, www.PetMeds.com.

About PetMed Express, Inc.

Founded in 1996, PetMeds is a pioneer in the direct-to-consumer pet healthcare sector. As a trusted national online pharmacy, PetMeds is licensed across all 50 states and staffed with expert pharmacists dedicated to supporting pet wellness, pets and pet parents, and the veterinarians who serve them. Through its PetMeds family of brands and through its PetCareRx subsidiary, the Company offers a comprehensive range of pet health solutions - including top-brand and generic pharmaceuticals, compounded medications, and better-for-your-pet OTC supplements and nutrition. Focused on value, convenience, and care, PetMeds and PetCareRx empower pet parents to help their dogs, cats, and horses live longer, healthier lives. To learn more, visit www.PetMeds.com and www.PetCareRx.com.

TORONTO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Generation Mining Limited (TSX: GENM) (OTCǪB: GENMF) (“Gen Mining” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that, further to its news release dated September 14, 2026, it has completed a non-brokered private placement (the “Offering”) of unsecured, subordinated convertible notes of the Company (the “Convertible Notes”) with Canada Growth Fund Inc. (“CGF”) and Canada Infrastructure Bank (“CIB”, and together with CGF, the “Noteholders”) for aggregate gross proceeds of $100 million, pursuant to which each Noteholder subscribed for $50 million of Convertible Notes.

The financing will help advance construction of the Marathon Project and support the development of a new domestic supply of copper and palladium in Northwestern Ontario.

“We sincerely appreciate the support of Canada Growth Fund and the Canada Infrastructure Bank,” said Jamie Levy, President and Chief Executive Officer of Gen Mining. “CGF and the CIB have been invaluable partners in our mission to build Canada’s next critical minerals mine. Their commitment to the Marathon Project reflects a shared focus on securing a domestic supply of copper and palladium for Canada.”

The Convertible Notes, the issuance of which was approved at a special meeting of shareholders of the Company held on November 26, 2026, are convertible into an aggregate of up to 111,111,111 Common Shares at an initial conversion price of $0.90 per Common Share, subject to anti-dilution adjustments for any share splits, consolidations, reclassifications and dividends paid in Common Shares. The Convertible Notes will bear interest at a rate of 9.0% per annum. Interest will be calculated and payable in cash semi-annually in arrears, to the extent that the distribution conditions under the senior secured project finance facility of the Company (the “Senior Facilities”), once in place following settlement and execution of final documentation, do not restrict such cash payment. The Convertible Notes will mature on the earlier of: (i) November 27, 2037; or (ii) if the Senior Facilities and the subordinated debt facility of $200 million with CIB (the “CIB Facility”) have been repaid in full, including through refinancing, then on the later of: (A) November 27, 2033; and (B) 12 months after the repayment of the Senior Facilities and the CIB Facility.

Additional shares may be issuable upon conversion of payment-in-kind interest. For additional information about the Convertible Notes, please refer to the Company’s management information circular dated October 19, 2026, available under the Company’s issuer profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

The proceeds from the Offering will be used by the Company to fund the development, construction and operation of the Company’s 100%-owned Marathon Copper-Palladium Project (the “Marathon Project”), together with associated general and administrative and financing costs.

The Offering remains subject to final approval of the Toronto Stock Exchange (“TSX”).

CGF-Related Disclosure Required under the Early Warning System

Immediately prior to the Offering, CGF had ownership and control over 138,950,000 Common Shares, representing approximately 19.8% of the issued and outstanding Common Shares on a non-diluted basis. Immediately after the completion of the Offering, CGF has ownership and control over (i) $50 million principal amount of Convertible Notes, initially convertible into an aggregate of up to 55,555,555 Common Shares, representing approximately 7.9% of the issued and outstanding Common Shares on a non-diluted basis and (ii) 138,950,000 Shares, representing approximately 19.8% of the issued and outstanding Common Shares on a non-diluted basis. The Convertible Notes are subject to a blocker feature, which prohibits the issuance of Common Shares upon the conversion of the Convertible Notes where such issuance would result in CGF, together with its affiliates, holding more than 19.9% of the issued and outstanding Common Shares. Conversion of the Convertible Notes in excess of the 19.9% threshold will be cash settled by the Company.

CGF acquired the Convertible Notes for investment purposes and not with a view to materially affecting control of the Company. Depending upon market conditions and other factors, including pursuant to certain rights granted to CGF under the investor rights agreement dated as of September 21, 2026, entered into between CGF and the Company, CGF may, from time to time, acquire or dispose of additional securities of the Company, in the open market, by private agreement or otherwise, or acquire interests in or enter into related financial instruments involving a security of the Company.

This portion of this news release is being issued pursuant to National Instrument 62-103 – The Early Warning System and Related Take-Over Bid and Insider Reporting Issuers. A copy of CGF’s early warning report with respect to the Offering will be filed on SEDAR+ ( www.sedarplus.ca ) promptly, and, in any event, within two business days from the date hereof. For more information or to obtain a copy of the report, please contact Mathieu St-Amand, Senior Manager, Public Relations and Government Affairs, Canada Growth Fund Investment Management, at +1 (514) 925-1500. CGF has a registered office located at 79 Wellington Street West, Suite 3000, Toronto, Ontario, M5K 1N2.

The head office of the Company is located at 100 King Street West, Suite 7010, Toronto, Ontario M5X 1B1.

About Generation Mining

Generation Mining Limited (TSX: GENM | OTCǪB: GENMF) is a Canadian critical minerals development company focused on building the Marathon Copper-Palladium Project in Northwestern Ontario. The Company has commenced construction of the Marathon Project, one of Canada’s largest undeveloped copper-palladium deposits and a future domestic source of copper, palladium, platinum, gold and silver.

The Marathon Project is expected to be a long-life, low-cost mining operation producing critical minerals essential to electrification, clean energy technologies and emissions reduction. NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / America's industrial strength has long been fueled by a willingness to challenge conventional thinking, embrace emerging technologies and transform scientific breakthroughs into practical commercial solutions. From advances in manufacturing to the digital revolution, that entrepreneurial mindset has helped shape the nation's economic identity.

Now, SMX (Security Matters) PLC (NASDAQ:SMX)(NASDAQ:SMXWW) is bringing that same spirit to artificial intelligence, developing a specialized scientific platform designed to help industries address complex material challenges while opening new possibilities for technological innovation.

Known as SMX Scientific Intelligence (SMX SCI), the platform takes a distinct approach to AI. Instead of concentrating on general-purpose applications, it is being developed to address the scientific and technical requirements of industrial material development, chemical compatibility, manufacturing and material verification.

The initiative embraces a principle central to American innovation: technology delivers its greatest value when it moves beyond theory and provides solutions to real-world problems.

AI Designed for Real-World Industry

Much of the excitement surrounding artificial intelligence has centered on its ability to generate content, analyze information and automate everyday tasks. SMX SCI is being developed with a more focused mission: helping scientific and industrial teams identify, assess and optimize materials used in manufacturing.

The platform is intended to create a comprehensive scientific codex of chemical agents, additives, molecular markers and supplementary materials.

By integrating AI-driven analysis with SMX's existing scientific expertise, it aims to assess chemical properties, production requirements, manufacturing conditions and potential industrial uses.

The goal is to streamline early-stage material research, ease laboratory workloads and allow technical teams to direct testing resources toward the most promising candidates.

For manufacturers, these capabilities could translate into quicker evaluations of material suitability, more efficient product development and faster responses to technical challenges.

SMX SCI is also being designed to provide preliminary regulatory and material compatibility assessments, including requirements applicable in the United States and other major international markets.

Final determinations involving material suitability and regulatory compliance will still require appropriate testing, validation and review.

Continuing America's Tradition of Turning Ideas Into Industry

American entrepreneurship has consistently demonstrated the value of transforming scientific discoveries into commercial opportunities.

SMX's proposed platform builds on that tradition by integrating artificial intelligence with established industrial technologies rather than positioning AI as a standalone product.

The company's molecular marking technology is designed to provide physical materials with persistent identification, while its Digital Material Passport infrastructure links those materials to records of their composition, quality, origin and lifecycle history.

SMX SCI would introduce an additional layer of scientific intelligence, helping determine suitable marking agents, additives and material solutions for specific industrial applications.

Working together, these technologies are intended to connect scientific research with manufacturing, distribution, recovery and recycling operations.

The broader infrastructure has potential uses across plastics, packaging, precious metals, electronics, semiconductors and other sectors essential to modern industrial supply chains.

This combination of scientific expertise, advanced technology and practical industrial applications reflects the resourcefulness that has historically distinguished American innovation.

Transforming Innovation Into Commercial Opportunity

The entrepreneurial potential of SMX SCI reaches beyond its scientific applications.

SMX anticipates introducing the platform into its internal operations during the first quarter of 2027, with full operations expected in the second quarter, contingent on successful development and testing.

The company also intends to launch a limited commercial edition during the second quarter of 2027, offering selected capabilities to customers around the world.

The proposed service would assist with material identification, additive selection, product enhancement and preliminary regulatory and compatibility evaluations.

Developed by SMX's internal team alongside specialized subcontractors, the platform brings together expertise in artificial intelligence, large language models, conversational AI and scientific data analysis.

The planned offering could create an additional commercial opportunity for SMX, expanding its activities beyond material identification and digital verification into AI-powered scientific services.

Creating the Infrastructure for Tomorrow's Materials

SMX SCI is also expected to advance the company's broader initiative to establish trusted global standards for certified and graded recycled plastics.

Through the integration of scientific intelligence, molecular marking and Digital Material Passports, SMX seeks to improve material identification, verification and lifecycle traceability.

The platform could also support AI-enabled functions connected to SMX's planned Plastic Circularity Credits, including credit eligibility evaluations, price discovery and connections between buyers and suppliers of certified recycled materials.

These standards and commercial mechanisms are still being developed.

For American industry, the larger opportunity lies in applying purpose-built artificial intelligence to some of manufacturing's most persistent challenges, from material efficiency and product development to supply chain transparency.

SMX SCI remains under development, and its eventual capabilities and commercial success will depend on testing, validation and market adoption.

Yet the vision behind the platform embodies a distinctly American philosophy: innovation is not measured simply by the technologies we invent, but by how effectively we put those inventions to work.

ABOUT SMX (SECURITY MATTERS) PLC

SMX (Security Matters) PLC (NASDAQ:SMX) develops molecular traceability and material authentication technologies designed to strengthen supply-chain transparency and integrity across global industries. Its platform embeds invisible molecular markers directly into physical materials, including solids, liquids and gases, allowing them to carry a persistent identity that can be detected and verified throughout their lifecycle.

LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--

Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. (NASDAQ: FFAI) (“Faraday Future”, “FF” or the “Company”), a California-based global Embodied AI (EAI) ecosystem company, today highlighted a significant milestone in its development as a Physical AI investment holding company. FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. (NASDAQ: FFR) (“FFR”) filed a preliminary Schedule 14C with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on November 25, marking the completion of all material matters required of both parties post deal closing. Following completion of the relevant procedures and assuming the issuances described in the filing, FFAI is expected to hold approximately 75% of FFR’s outstanding common stock. Based on FFR’s closing share price on November 25, the implied value of this expected ownership position would be approximately $41 million.

Faraday Future Highlights Expected FFR Equity Position Valued at Approximately $41 Million, Offering FFAI Stockholders Participation in FFR’s Potential Long-Term Value Creation

As previously announced, the robotics business incubated by FFAI was combined into FFR on October 23, 2026. The transaction gives the robotics business room to develop independently. The robotics business will use FFR as a standalone platform for financing and accounting, which will make its performance more transparent and help investors manage a closed loop from investment to results.

FFAI’s expected ownership position represents a significant milestone for its future development and provides FFAI stockholders with an opportunity to participate in FFR’s potentially substantial future value creation and returns. It also reinforces Faraday Future’s long-term commitment to the robotics business it incubated, as FFR advances its technologies, products, strategic partnerships and commercialization initiatives. Through its distribution network across 35 countries and regions, Dogness aims to commercialize its AI-powered pet products and capture new growth opportunities in the smart pet care industry.

Extensive Global Distribution Network Supports AI Product Commercialization

Dogness's channel network now covers 35 countries and regions worldwide. It sells through global retailers and specialized pet channels including Walmart, Costco, Petco and Pet Valu, online platforms such as Amazon and Chewy, as well as brand and industry partners like Velcro. This broad network and the Company's long-standing relationships provide a foundation for presenting products, gathering market feedback and exploring new collaborations. They also support Dogness's efforts to introduce its new AI products to different markets and adapt its product portfolio to local needs, strengthening its relationships with major international retailers.

Driving AI Innovation in Smart Pet Care Through a Structured Matrix of AI Products

While strengthening its established pet supplies business, Dogness continues to expand the development and production of AI-enabled pet products. The Company continues to invest in R&D for intelligent functions and products designed for specific pet care needs, pursuing a two-track approach that combines an established product foundation with continued AI innovation.

  • New AI Products: Advancing the AI Strategy through Smart Feeding

At CIPS 2026, Dogness showcased the F01B and F10B AI feeders, allowing attendees to explore smart feeding and scenario-based interaction features through hands-on demonstrations. The 3.6-liter F10B, built with Google Gemini, features a high-definition night-vision camera and AI-powered behavior recognition that alerts owners to unusual activity through the Dogness mobile app. The F01B offers a larger 8-liter capacity in a distinct design. AI feeders are an important entry point within the Company's expanding portfolio of AI pet products. Dogness continues to invest in R&D and refine products around real-world pet care needs, advancing the application of AI capabilities in everyday feeding scenarios.

More importantly, Dogness's AI strategy is not a collection of standalone devices but a scenario-driven product matrix. Its technical strengths are reflected in three areas: first, scenario-based interaction capabilities developed around high-frequency pet care scenarios including feeding, interaction and location tracking; second, integrated hardware-software-scenario design that enables AI features to deliver a seamless user experience throughout real-world usage journeys; and third, sustained R&D and iteration capabilities, underpinned by the Company's continued investment in intelligent function development and scenario-based product pipeline reserves. AI feeders serve as the primary entry point, as the product matrix extends into location-tracking use cases, with AI-enabled water fountains in the pipeline to form a multi-scenario AI product matrix covering feeding, hydration and location tracking.

  • Established Product Portfolio as a Robust Foundation for AI-Driven Growth

At CIPS 2026, Dogness also presented quick-release pet leashes, the slow-recovery R06 retractable leash, paw cleaner cups, training mats and reflective collars, covering everyday walking, cleaning, training and visibility needs.

The established portfolio delivers four key pillars supporting Dogness's AI product development: an established customer base and repeat-purchase relationships that create a natural on-ramp for AI products; brand recognition that lowers market education costs for new AI offerings; an integrated, in-house supply chain covering design and R&D, material sourcing, manufacturing and quality control, which supports production of AI products with consistent quality and effective cost control; and existing sales channels, including distributor networks, retail outlets and e-commerce operations, to support the distribution and promotion of AI products.

Furthermore, Dogness's traditional and AI businesses unlock opportunities for cross-selling and mutual promotion. Channel credibility and user relationships built through its established product lineup help AI products gain market traction. In turn, AI products elevate the brand's technological positioning and customer value, reinforcing the established product portfolio. As such, Dogness has built a growth framework wherein its established product portfolio stabilizes the core business and its structured AI product matrix is intended to drive incremental growth.

Silong Chen, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Dogness, commented: "CIPS 2026 enables us to leverage our well-established worldwide sales network and customer base, supported by end-to-end R&D and manufacturing systems, to further advance our strategic transformation from a traditional global pet products manufacturer into a global AI-powered smart pet care technology company, and accelerate the global commercialization of AI-powered pet products."

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - TruSilver Metals Corp. (TSXV: TAG) (OTCQB: TAGMF) (FSE: XJ10) ("TruSilver" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that its common shares have been approved for trading on the OTCQB® Venture Market, operated by OTC Markets Group Inc., and commenced trading under the symbol "TAGMF" on November 27, 2026. The Company's common shares will continue to trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "TAG".

The OTCQB is a U.S. trading venue for entrepreneurial and development-stage companies. To qualify, companies must be current in their reporting and pass an annual verification and management certification process. The listing gives U.S. investors a simple way to buy and hold TruSilver shares through their existing brokerage accounts, in U.S. dollars and during U.S. market hours.

Highlights

  • Three markets in one month. TruSilver began trading on the TSX Venture Exchange on October 27, 2026, on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange on November 10, 2026 (FSE: XJ10; WKN: A42QTR), and now on the OTCQB.

  • Broader investor reach. The OTCQB listing opens TruSilver to U.S. retail and institutional investors, alongside its existing Canadian and European shareholder base.

  • Drilling at Sturgis-Walton. TruSilver's planned 2026/27 diamond drilling program of approximately 3,500 metres across five holes is commencing with hole ST-26-01A at its 100%-owned Sturgis-Walton Silver Project, adjacent to the historic Walton Mine.

Michael Gross, President and Chief Executive Officer of TruSilver, commented:

"Adding the OTCQB means investors in Canada, Europe and the United States can now own TruSilver on a market close to home. The U.S. has one of the deepest pools of capital for silver and precious-metals explorers anywhere, and we want those investors following our story from the start. That story is about to be tested with the drill. Sturgis-Walton sits next to one of the historic highest-grade silver mines in Nova Scotia's history, and our geophysics points to a target at depth that has never been properly drilled. Over the coming months our job is simple: drill it, report what we find, and keep our shareholders informed every step of the way."

TruSilver Metals Corp. owns 100% of the Sturgis-Walton Silver Project in Hants County, Nova Scotia, free of a net smelter return royalty, adjacent to the historic Walton Mine, a past barite producer and silver-rich lead-zinc-copper mine, where historical sources report mined ore head grades of 350-933 g/t silver (Ag).¹ TruSilver is commencing drilling of hole ST-26-01A, the first hole of its 2026/27 drill program, aimed squarely at the Sturgis Target: a large, dense and electrically conductive body approximately 1.5 km south of the Walton Mine. The Sturgis Target is where five years of magnetic, audio-magnetotelluric (AMT) and gravity surveys, drilling and 3D modelling converge. The Company's working hypothesis, which this program is designed to test, is that the Sturgis Target may represent a somewhat deeper and along-strike part of the same mineralizing system that formed the Walton Mine. A drilling permit is in place. TruSilver's 2023 hole, ST-23-001 (collared approximately 850 m from the mine), was drilled between the Walton Mine and the newer Sturgis Target, and returned 48.8 g/t silver and 0.19% copper over 19.0 metres in the Macumber Formation, the rock unit that hosted mineralization at the Walton Mine, potentially indicating distal lower-grade mineralization between the two zones.² In late 2025, Rio Tinto Exploration Canada Inc. staked all open mineral claims in the Minas sub-basin, comprising 2,363 claims under 30 exploration licences, surrounding the Sturgis-Walton Silver Project. Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Railtown AI Technologies Inc. (CSE: RAIL) (OTCQB: RLAIF) ("Railtown" or the "Company") today announced new on-demand model evaluation capabilities that use data captured from actual agent runs to compare alternative AI models. The technology extends Railtown's agent observability capabilities and helps developers and enterprises assess whether a lower-cost model or a different deployment environment can meet an application's quality and reliability requirements.

Evaluating Models Against Real Application Workloads

Railtown's agent observability technology can run locally or through its Conductr cloud platform, giving developers visibility into agent execution across development and production environments. The new capabilities use historical execution data to evaluate alternative models against real application workloads.

Developers can use these evaluations to identify tasks that may run on smaller, more efficient models, assess whether suitable workloads can move to a device or privately controlled infrastructure, and reduce reliance on any one provider. As new models become available, teams can revisit model choices throughout an application's life.

Evaluating Models in Apple's AI Ecosystem

Combining the new evaluation capabilities with Railtown's open-source Railtracks Swift Agent Development Kit (ADK) and agent observability gives Apple developers a way to assess which workloads could run on Apple's on-device foundation models or on a model running on Apple's Private Cloud Compute, where available.

Moving suitable tasks to an on-device model can reduce external inference costs, keep those model requests on the device and enable offline functionality where supported. Eligible developers can also evaluate Apple's cloud-hosted model for tasks that need more reasoning capacity or a larger context window.

"Developers should be able to look at the work their agents already do and ask where a smaller model can deliver the quality they need," said Marwan Haddad, CTO and Co-Founder of Railtown AI. "For an Apple developer, that might mean moving part of a workflow onto the device. For an enterprise, it might mean running a model on infrastructure it controls. In both cases, the decision starts with data from the application itself."

Supporting Private and Sovereign AI Deployments

Enterprises and governments seeking greater control over sensitive data and intellectual property can use the technology to assess whether open-weight models running on infrastructure they control meet the requirements of existing applications.

In Canada, Railtown sees an opportunity to complement investment in sovereign AI infrastructure by helping organizations identify which workloads can move to domestically controlled computing environments and what changes those workloads may require.

The new capabilities extend Railtown's agent development tools, which include the open-source Railtracks Swift and Python ADKs, knowledge retrieval technology, agent observability and the Conductr platform. The Company is also exploring ways to build on its observability and evaluation technology to help developers optimize prompts and agent workflows.

Railtown expects to make the evaluation capabilities available to developers soon and plans to publish a technical blog demonstrating how to use them.

Railtown AI Technologies Inc. is an AI technology company developing tools and infrastructure that enable developers and organizations to build, deploy, manage and observe AI-powered applications and agents.

Its technology includes Conductr, an agentic AI orchestration, deployment and observability platform; Railengine, its knowledge and data infrastructure; and Railtracks, its open-source Agent Development Kit.

Tirzepatide and GLP3 become the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach production, 100% tested and manufactured in the United States by a single manufacturer producing exclusively for the Company; full lineup targeted for sale by Q1 2027

Highlights

  • 20,000 tirzepatide and 20,000 GLP3 patches ordered after both passed formal U.S. testing, the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order
  • The Recovery Patch (BPC-157) is on sale now; 20,000 Thymosin Alpha-1 patches ordered for January 2027 delivery; tirzepatide and GLP3 ordered today; full needle-free lineup targeted for sale by Q1 2027
  • Both are GLP-1 category patches, aimed at a global GLP-1 market valued at approximately US$66 billion in 2025 and projected to reach US$185.3 billion by 2033[2,3]
  • 100% tested and manufactured in the United States, by one U.S. manufacturer, with every patch produced solely for the Company under exclusive manufacturing rights
  • No needle, no mixing, no measuring, no refrigeration

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - The Precision Peptide Company (CSE: BPC) (OTCQB: PNGAF) (the "Company"), a publicly traded wellness company focused on advanced peptide formulations and delivery systems, today announced that its tirzepatide and GLP3 transdermal patches have each passed formal U.S. testing and that it has ordered 20,000 units of each from its exclusive U.S. manufacturer. They are the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order, following BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1, and the Company is targeting a full needle-free lineup on sale by the first quarter of 2027, up from the single patch on sale today.

The tirzepatide patch was announced as under development on August 19, 2026 and entered formal U.S. testing on October 13, 2026. The GLP3 patch entered development on October 20, 2026. Both are in the Company's metabolic and weight-management category, and both have now passed the same U.S. testing stage that the Company's BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1 ("TA1") patches passed before their own production orders.

100% Tested and Manufactured in the United States

Every patch in the line follows the same production and testing process: formulated in the United States, tested in the United States by an independent laboratory, produced in the United States, then released. The first patch through that process, The Recovery Patch (BPC-157), recorded 95.5% chromatographic purity and a quantified 2.02 mg dose per patch in independent laboratory testing, exceeding the 95% threshold widely used as the benchmark for high-purity peptide products.

TA1 followed with a 20,000-unit order at 2 mg per patch. Tirzepatide and GLP3 have now cleared the same stage. All four formulations are produced by one U.S. manufacturer solely for the Company under the exclusive manufacturing rights announced on October 22, 2026, so that one testing standard and one production standard apply across the whole line.

The Needle-Free Line at a Glance

BPC-157 (The Recovery Patch)On saleIndependent U.S. laboratory testing recorded 95.5% purity and a 2.02 mg dose per patch (May 19, 2026); approximately 20,000 units received July 2026 (July 14, 2026); available at store.precisionpep.co
Thymosin Alpha-1 (TA1)In productionEntered formal U.S. testing September 2026; 20,000 units ordered October 2026 at 2 mg per patch, delivery expected January 2027 (October 7, 2026)
TirzepatideIn productionDevelopment announced August 2026 (August 19, 2026); entered formal U.S. testing October 2026 (October 13, 2026); testing passed; 20,000 units ordered November 2026
GLP3In productionDevelopment announced October 2026 (October 20, 2026); formal U.S. testing passed; 20,000 units ordered November 2026
MOTS-cIn developmentDevelopment announced November 26, 2026

 

A Full Line by Q1 2027

The Recovery Patch, on sale since July 2026, was the first product in the Company's needle-free range. With 20,000-unit orders now placed for TA1, tirzepatide and GLP3, the Company is targeting a full needle-free lineup on sale by the end of the first quarter of 2027. Each patch will be sold through the Company's direct-to-consumer website and its wholesale program for clinics, medical spas, gyms and retailers in all 50 U.S. states.

No Needle, No Mixing, No Refrigeration

Injectable peptides, including the Company's own prescription vials, are typically supplied as a powder that must be mixed with sterile water, measured into a syringe, injected and kept refrigerated. The Company's patches remove those steps. The Company's patches are applied to the skin, and each patch delivers a pre-measured dose: no needle, no mixing, no measuring, no cold storage. Discreet, portable and consistent from one dose to the next, they fit into a daily routine and open peptides to the many people who were interested but prefer not to use a syringe.

Market Context

Tirzepatide and GLP3 are the Company's two patches in the metabolic and weight-management category. The global GLP-1 market was valued at approximately US$66 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach US$185.3 billion by 2033,[2,3] with injectable delivery accounting for 69.1% of the market in 2025.[2] The broader global peptide therapeutics market was valued at US$56.06 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach US$87.21 billion by 2035, with North America the largest regional market.[1] The Company believes that U.S.-based development, testing and manufacturing, combined with a needle-free format, position it to compete as those markets expand.

The foregoing market data is provided as context for the Company's product development activities and should not be construed as a projection of the Company's future revenue or market share.

Pratap Sandhu, CEO of The Precision Peptide Company, commented:

"We are making significant progress in turning our needle-free patches into a commercial product portfolio. In just four months, we have grown from one patch on sale to three additional patches ordered for production, including 40,000 tirzepatide and GLP3 patches following successful U.S. testing. Our exclusive U.S. manufacturing partnership gives us a strong foundation to expand production while maintaining consistent quality standards. We are targeting commercial availability of all four patches by March 2027, with MOTS-c now also in development as our fifth. Our priority is clear: accelerate commercialization, expand our product portfolio and establish The Precision Peptide Company as a leader in needle-free peptide delivery."

St. Lewis, Newfoundland and Labrador--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Search Minerals Inc. ("Petra") and Harder Investments Ltd. ("Harder"), for the Lenders to provide the Company a C$1.4 million secured convertible loan (the "Loan"). The proceeds from the Loan will be primarily used to repay the Company's C$700,000 principal amount convertible note issued to Texas Critical Minerals, LLC ("TCM") in October 2024, which matured on October 25, 2025, together with all accrued interest.

The principal amount of the Loan will mature and be repayable in full on the date which is three years from closing, and will be convertible into common shares at the option of the Lenders at any time prior to the close of business on the maturity date at a conversion price of $0.30 per share. The principal amount of the Loan will bear interest at 8.5% per annum, payable annually on December 31, commencing December 31, 2027. Subject to the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange ("TSXV"), Search will have the option to pay interest in common shares in lieu of cash at the market price for the common shares at the time the interest becomes payable. Any conversion that would result in a Lender becoming a Control Person (as defined in the policies of the TSXV) will be subject to prior TSXV approval, including shareholder approval. The Loan will be secured by a pledge of the shares of the Company's subsidiaries Alterra Resources Inc. and 86857 Newfoundland & Labrador Inc., together with guarantees and personal property security granted by those subsidiaries.

Upon completion, the transaction is expected to:

  • Lower interest rate costs: reduce the interest rate on the TCM note being repaid from 15% to 8.5%;
  • Reduce TCM's claims: resolve the claim TCM has filed against the Company relating to the note, one of three claims filed by TCM against the Company as disclosed in the Company's financial statements. With respect to the two remaining claims, the Company continues to dispute the amounts alleged to be owing, believes it has credible defences, and intends to defend its position while remaining focused on advancing its core projects and protecting shareholder interests; and
  • Improve working capital: remove past-due debt owed to TCM from the Company's working capital deficit, subject to final accounting treatment, by extending the maturity dates for the Company's debt and treating such liability as non-current, and provide funds for general working capital.

Jonathan Beigle, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Search Minerals, commented: "We appreciate the continued support of our largest shareholders. This financing allows us to repay the TCM note, lower our interest costs and extend maturities. This will allow us to focus all of our effort on advancing our projects for the benefit of all shareholders."

Closing of the transaction is expected in mid-December, 2026. The Term Sheet is a preliminary binding agreement; completion of the transaction remains subject to, among other things, negotiation and execution of definitive documentation, approval of the Company's Board of Directors and a special committee of independent directors, acceptance of the TSXV, and satisfaction of customary conditions. There can be no assurance that the transaction will be completed on the terms described or at all.

The Loan, and any common shares issued on conversion of the Loan, will be subject to a hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance of the Loan, in accordance with applicable securities legislation and TSXV policies. Any common shares issued in payment of interest will be subject to a hold period of four months and one day from their date of issuance.

Petra is controlled by Michael Pearson, a director of the Company, and Petra also owns more than 10% of the voting securities of the Company. Accordingly, Petra is a "related party" of the Company. Harder owns more than 10% of the voting securities of the Company. Accordingly, Harder is also a "related party" of the Company. The Company controls a belt 64 km long and 2 km wide that is road accessible, on tidewater, and located near three local communities. NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / SMX, a pioneer in molecular marking and digital material authentication technology, was featured this week in an opinion piece published by The Denver Post examining the need for greater transparency, traceability and accountability in Colorado's evolving recycling economy.

The article, titled "Colorado Has Built a Recycling Framework. Now It Needs Proof," was published on November 23 and addresses one of the most pressing challenges facing states as they implement ambitious environmental legislation: establishing credible proof that materials are being recycled and returned to the economy.

Colorado has made significant strides in advancing sustainability through its Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) legislation, which places greater accountability on manufacturers and producers for the lifecycle of packaging materials. The next opportunity lies in establishing the technological infrastructure to support those policies.

SMX's proprietary molecular marking technology and Digital Material Passport Platform (DMPP) are designed to address this challenge by giving physical materials a persistent identity linked to a secure digital record. The technology enables businesses to authenticate materials, establish chain of custody, document recycled content and create audit-ready records throughout the supply chain.

By making recycled materials identifiable and certifiable, SMX aims to help manufacturers, recyclers and regulators move beyond traditional reporting methods toward a system grounded in scientific proof.

The Denver Post placement comes as the national conversation around recycling increasingly shifts from environmental commitments to measurable outcomes, regulatory compliance and the economic competitiveness of recycled materials.

SMX's technology is designed to help bridge the gap between legislative ambition and industrial execution, providing the tools necessary to build a more transparent, accountable and commercially viable circular economy.

The Denver Post article is one in a series of recent media profiles about SMX. Other stories have run in Tech Crunch, Benzinga, Forbes, the Boston Herald, the Chicago Tribune, Los Angeles Tribune, Miami Herald, Time, and Rolling Stone, among others.

About SMX

SMX (Security Matters) PLC (NASDAQ:SMX)(NASDAQ:SMXWW) develops molecular marking, authentication and digital traceability technologies designed to bring transparency, accountability and trust to global supply chains. Through its proprietary technology and Digital Material Passport Platform, SMX enables materials to carry a persistent identity throughout their lifecycle, supporting regulatory compliance, supply chain integrity and the transition to a circular economy.
